one_line: Hold up three finished results one per second, then show the process and end with the result in use.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down on white: an adult hand holds up a finished sunflower bookmark; 0:01 a cat bookmark; 0:02 an octopus bookmark. No speech (transcript only "תודה רבה"), no text. 0:03 a tub of Giotto crayons in two hands.
q1_hook.why: A new finished, colourful item every second is a concrete reason to stay, with no intro (H1, E1). The first frame is a clear, large cover image (H7). But no voice or text says what these are or how to get them, so the hook only works as a picture (H6, T3, H2).

beats.what: Hand holds up finished sunflower, cat and octopus bookmarks, one per second
beats.why: Result-first montage, a new picture per second

beats.what: Two hands hold the Giotto CERA JUMBO MAXI tub, then an open TURBOPRO marker box
beats.why: Names the tools while attention is high

beats.what: A small hand colours the animal bookmark page "סימניות חיות" with red and green markers
beats.why: The process begins, outlines fill quickly

beats.what: Green wax crayon on a dragon, purple mane, giraffe patches; the page fills with colour
beats.why: Shows crayon and marker coverage side by side

beats.what: Garden page "סימניות גינה": a vine, then a flower, coloured in
beats.why: A second page keeps the process fresh

beats.what: A children's book with a bookmark peeking out, then a mushroom bookmark held over an open spread
beats.why: Shows the use and echoes the opening

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: a yes/no question, "מי שרוצה את הקבצים, תגיבו על הריל ואשלח בשמחה" (comment for the free files), and a link to the markers in a story. The video itself asks for nothing.
q2_flow.why: A cut about every 1.4 s keeps the middle moving (R3). The held-up bookmark in the last shot mirrors the first frame, so a replay feels natural (R4). At 22 s it fits one visual demo (R2). The ending is quick, not padded (R1). The free file gives a reason to comment (R6).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption: "מי שרוצה את הקבצים, תגיבו על הריל ואשלח בשמחה", then "הלינק לטושים יחכה לכם בסטורי או שתרשמו לי", plus the question "רוצות להכין גם סימניות צבעוניות מיוחדות?". No comment word.
q3_cta.why: Commenting for a free file has a real purpose (C2, R6), though no keyword is named, so sending is manual (C3). Two different asks, files and a marker link, split the action (C1). Neither is said or shown in the video, and both sit low in a long caption (C6).

q4_shown.what: Finished bookmarks 0:00 to 0:03; the Giotto crayon tub and marker box, labels legible, 0:03 to 0:05; a small hand colouring printed pages with markers and a crayon 0:05 to 0:19; the mushroom bookmark in a children's book at the end. No price, no face.
q4_shown.why: Result first, then the tools, then the process, then the result in a real book. The Giotto tools are first seen at 0:03, past the 2 s mark (S1), then stay in frame (H3, K5). Hands only, with a child's hand but no face (S4, S5).

q5_edit.what: 15 shots in 21.6 s, about 1.4 s each; straight cuts, one every 1 to 2 s. Colouring is sped up or cut (a bookmark goes from outline to filled in about 3 s). No text, no speech. Ends on the held-up bookmark.
q5_edit.why: Movement from second 0 gives a change at once (E1). Speed-up is on hands and an object (E3). Quicker than the 2 to 5 s guide, but cuts stay in one scene (E2). It ends on its payoff, no tail (E8). No audio or text for a muted viewer (E4).

q6_topic.what: Colouring printable bookmarks that peek out of a children's book; serves a parent who reads with children and wants a simple craft and the free files.
q6_topic.why: A free printable is something to ask for and to send to another parent (R5). The caption's "מטורף שהגענו לגיל הזה שצריך סימניות" is a relatable parent moment (K6). The feeling is calm and satisfying, not a high-arousal peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Phone fixed above a white table in even light: finished bookmarks in an adult hand; an eye-level close-up of the tub; top-down on the pages with a small hand colouring, markers along the top edge; a top-down book, then a close-up over a spread.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands put the viewer in the maker's seat (F5). Labels and colours fill the frame in the 0:03 to 0:04 close-ups, legible on a phone (F4). All live motion (F8), sharp and evenly lit but homemade (F7). Full-screen vertical (F1).

q8_text.on_screen: No overlay text, no subtitles, no CTA, no logo. The only Hebrew is printed on things: "סימניות חיות" on the page (0:05 to 0:15), "סימניות גינה" (0:18), and part of a book cover (0:19).
q8_text.caption: "הסימניות הכי מיוחדות שראיתן 😍 📖". About 120 words: a question, how they were made and cut, the two Giotto products, a nostalgic line, the file offer, 5 hashtags, last line "בשיתוף @giotto_israel".
q8_text.why: With no overlay text, nothing carries the message for a muted viewer, so the offer lives only in the caption (T1, T3). The caption uses searchable words (סימניות, צבעי שעווה, טושים) and five specific hashtags (T7). The partner line comes last, after the hashtags, with no paid label (T8).

weak_points: The free-files offer is only in the caption, split from a second ask; no voice or on-screen text at all; the product names flash for 2 s; the caption question is yes/no; the partnership line is the last line.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on three finished results held up one per second, show the label, film hands only top-down, and end on the item in a real book.
not_verified: Whether there is music (transcript only "תודה רבה", no speech evident). Whether the small hand is a child's: it looks so at 0:05 to 0:18. Correction to coded file: it is not clearly an adult's hand; adult hands appear at 0:00 to 0:03 and at 0:21. Whether a story link existed.
